rows.prompt: In the clinic supply closet, a person must sort a delayed request queue. They pick up a bin labeled 'Urgent' but then notice a faded tag on the back, indicating it was for a patient whose chart was closed last year. A slow breath escapes their lips as they set the bin down carefully, then pick up another, checking each label twice before placing it in the correct bin.

Their shoulders relax slightly as they place the package aside and move on to the next one, their pace picking up slightly.
